Job Summary

This role is responsible for the complete lifecycle management of wireless/mobile products and applications, driving their success from conception to market. The main purpose is to align product development with organizational strategy and objectives, ensuring a competitive and innovative product portfolio. Key areas of focus include market research and analysis to identify consumer trends and opportunities, defining product features and functionalities, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to oversee product development. Furthermore, this role involves creating product documentation and providing crucial product knowledge and technical support to sales and marketing teams. Ultimately, the role leverages market feedback to continuously evaluate product performance and guide future product direction, ensuring ongoing relevance and market leadership.

Key Responsibilities (Sequential Workflow)

Workflow
Key Responsibility

Market Research and Opportunity Analysis
Oversee the quality and relevance of market research activities related to B2B Enterprise Edge products, ensure alignment with strategic objectives, and approve final research analysis.

Product Strategy and Roadmap Development
Approve and take ownership of the B2B Enterprise Edge product strategy and roadmap, ensuring they align with organizational goals.

Requirements Gathering and Feature Definition
Validate collected requirements for B2B Enterprise Edge solutions, prioritize product features, and ensure alignment with business objectives and customer needs.

Cross-functional Collaboration and Development Management
Oversee cross-functional alignment for B2B Enterprise Edge product development, proactively remove obstacles, and ensure delivery timelines are maintained throughout the product development process.

Go-to-Market Planning and Launch
Approve the go-to-market strategy for B2B Enterprise Edge products and oversee its execution to ensure the product launch is successful.

Product Performance Monitoring and Feedback Integration
Oversee B2B Enterprise Edge product performance monitoring efforts, make decisions on product improvement initiatives, and ensure customer and market feedback is addressed.

Product Lifecycle Management and Innovation
Own the B2B Enterprise Edge product lifecycle management strategy, approve major product enhancements, and ensure all innovation initiatives support overall business objectives.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
